trigger: Real workflows needed inactive Chrome page controls and uploads without native file pickers or another vendor browser driver.

tests.browser: Chrome for Testing 155.0.8059.84 on macOS arm64
tests.transport: OpenSky MV3 extension + native messaging + local broker

limits: Owner must load the extension once in the existing Chrome profile. This release does not silently sideload or restart Chrome.
Real browser tests used a disposable headless profile, not signed-in provider accounts.
Chrome debugger UI remains visible; user detach and emergency pause are retained. Native emergency stop is polled during requests and cannot undo delivered input.
Some child-frame clicks use DOM activation. Protected pages, native dialogs, closed shadow roots, canvases and provider restrictions may remain unsupported.
Older MCP processes must reconnect or use the updated CLI/SDK.
Business approvals and provider holds are preserved; no completed tasks were restarted.
